subject.title: Google Chat: markdown renders as raw text; typing indicator says 'OpenClaw is typing' instead of app name

question: Should Google Chat outbound text convert OpenClaw Markdown into Google Chat's supported text-message markup dialect, or should the plugin intentionally strip unsupported Markdown to plain text?
rationale: Current source marks Google Chat as Markdown-capable but has no Google Chat renderer, and prior discussion disagreed on stripping because Google Chat supports a limited formatting dialect.

options.title: Convert supported markup
options.body: Add a Google Chat renderer that maps common assistant Markdown into Google Chat-supported text syntax and flattens unsupported constructs predictably.

options.title: Plain text only
options.body: Treat Google Chat as a plain-text channel by stripping Markdown and updating metadata, docs, and tests to remove the current Markdown-capable contract.

options.title: Typing fix only
options.body: Land or sponsor only the display-name fallback now and explicitly track Markdown rendering as a separate channel policy decision.

recommendation.title: Convert supported markup
recommendation.body: Add a Google Chat renderer that maps common assistant Markdown into Google Chat-supported text syntax and flattens unsupported constructs predictably.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest combined routing signal across original Google Chat commits and later reply-delivery refactors.
